text:
Meera: Heads-up — Norbit just reported one inbound pallet stuck at the regional port, customs flagged an electronics inspection. ETA pushed ~5 days. This impacts the APAC Dedicated ramp and a Marketplace commitment next week. @Ethan @Sofia please advise next steps.
Ethan: Ugh. How many units are on that pallet?
Meera: 40 GPUs total, partner says about half are immediately releasable after inspection but the rest need a firmware compliance check. They offered a partial airfreight option for 8 units (expedite at partner cost + customs brokerage).
Sofia: If 20 are releasable we can probably meet the internal QA schedule but the Marketplace customer (TempoAI) has a reserved launch on Nov 10. Do we have any spare burst capacity we can borrow? :thinking_face:
Carlos: EU pool has ~12 spare slots this week if we can shift routing and reassign reservations. It'd be disruptive to some lower-priority test queues though.
Meera: @Carlos ok can you sketch a quick swap plan? We need to preserve SLA-backed seats first.
Ethan: Quick plan: move 8 reserved seats from eu-pool -> apac-pool for 72h, keep 4 for canary, leave 4 as buffer. If airfreight 8 arrives, we return immediately.
Priya: From GTM, TempoAI is on a soft commitment but we promised no customer-visible degradation for launch. If we reduce their capacity can we offer an announcement delay or temporary scale-back with credit?
Jules (Orion SI): For the SI pilot, we can throttle async workloads and still validate features with 8 nodes. Staged delivery is acceptable on our side if you confirm timeline.
Meera: Good — so immediate ask: authorize the eu->apac swap of 8 seats and request partner to airship 8 units as option B. Who can approve the routing change?
Carlos: I can do the routing change if EngInfra ok's cross-region transfer for reserved units. I'll ping eng-infra now.
Ethan: I'll open a short runbook draft for the swap and add rollback steps.
ops-bot: deploy-request: routing-change eu-pool->apac-pool for 8 seats requested by Carlos. Awaiting eng-infra approval.
Sofia: Also confirm cost: partner airfreight estimate ~ $12k for 8 units? Need finance OK if we go that route.
Meera: @Priya can we offer TempoAI a 10% credit for a 48h capacity shortfall and push their full-scale announce by 48h if needed?
Priya: Yeah we can draft a one-time credit and a customer note. Prefer to avoid delaying their public announcement but we'll keep that as backup.
Ethan: snippet of the swap plan I pushed to the doc:
```
reserve_swap:
  from: eu-pool
  to: apac-pool
  units: 8
  duration: 72h
  fallback: return when airship arrives
```
Meera: Next steps: Carlos to request eng-infra approval (ASAP), Ethan to finish runbook, Meera to confirm partner airfreight ETA and cost, Priya to prepare customer comms. If anyone objects to the swap by EOD speak now. Otherwise I'll escalate to legal/finance for airship payment approval.
Jules (Orion SI): Thanks, we can flex. Keep us posted on the final manifest.
Carlos: pinged eng-infra. They replied: "can do but need signed temporary routing policy waiver." Routing will be blocked until waiver is in place. Gonna loop Legal.
Meera: Ok looping Legal & Finance. Thanks team — targeting decision in 3 hours. :white_check_mark:
